# generateViewerSrcdoc

## Summary

Returns the viewer harness HTML with the model .js URL baked in (`window.SCULPT_MODEL_URL`), for use as an iframe's `srcdoc` attribute. Because the document arrives via srcdoc, the browser never requests an .html file from the realm — so it works regardless of how the realm routes text/html navigations — and a srcdoc document inherits the embedding page's origin, so the studio can still call the harness's window API and the model .js fetch stays same-origin. Implemented as a one-line delegation to `generateViewerHarnessHtml(modelUrl)`.

## Import

```ts
import { generateViewerSrcdoc } from '../util/code-export';
```

## Usage

`SculptedModel` (`sculpted-model.gts`) renders every exported model through it, and the studio (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) falls back to it when reading the model source for inline embedding fails.
